title: Bluesun BSM15K-B local Hopewind register evidence
summary: Owner supplied successful local FC03 reads of all three protocol-0237 telemetry blocks, followed by 40002/4 and 40011/3 settings reads on 2026-09-30. Confirms a 15 kW-rated device, local telemetry and settings readback, not control writes or an exact retail-model fingerprint.
